metadata.source: NASA Exoplanet Archive — Planetary Systems Composite Parameters
metadata.query: select hostname,pl_name,sy_dist,ra,dec,st_rad,st_mass,st_teff,pl_orbsmax,pl_orbper,pl_rade,pl_bmasse,pl_orbsmax_reflink,pl_rade_reflink,pl_orbsmaxlim,pl_radelim,pl_controv_flag from pscomppars where sy_dist <= 15 and pl_controv_flag = 0 order by sy_dist,hostname,pl_name
metadata.selection: Confirmed composite-table rows within 15 pc, controversial flag = 0.
